title: The Midnight Train
briefing: A suspect claims he was nowhere near the Grand Hotel on the night of the robbery. The railway timetable says otherwise, if you can show he was on the train.

atoms.T: The suspect took the midnight train
atoms.A: The suspect arrived in town before one o'clock
atoms.H: The suspect was seen at the Grand Hotel
atoms.R: The suspect carried a red case

statements.speaker: Station master
statements.text: The midnight train is never late. If he took it, he arrived in town before one.

statements.speaker: Night clerk
statements.text: Nobody gets past my desk unseen. If he arrived before one, he was seen at the hotel.

clues.text: The night clerk wears thick glasses.
The porter remembers him: he boarded the midnight train, carrying a red case.

conclusion.text: The suspect was seen at the Grand Hotel.
